content_sections.text: Ramaiah Medical College Hospital is the hospital that is recruiting for both posts. Applications are received on a hospital HR email address under the msruas.ac.in domain.

content_sections.heading: RMCH Manager and Audiologist cum Speech Therapist Vacancy Details 2026
RMCH Manager and Audiologist cum Speech Therapist Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master of Public Health. Experience: 5 years in a relevant field is essential. Age limit: 55 years. Job description: Liaising with the Government for approvals of health schemes. Coordinating with the Health department (PHC, Namma clinics) for organising camps and giving publicity about the services in the hospital. Supervision of ICMR NCDIR HSBR and other projects. Qualification: Bachelor in Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology. Experience: 3 years in a relevant field is desirable, so it is preferred but not mandatory. Age limit: 35 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RMCH Manager and Audiologist cum Speech Therapist Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV and the other relevant documents for the post you want. Email them to [email protected] . Send the application by 11 November 2026 for Manager - Health Care Services, or by 5 December 2026 for Audiologist cum Speech Therapist.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the Manager - Health Care Services post?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 November 2026, a week from today.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the Audiologist cum Speech Therapist post?
faq.answer: Applications for this post are accepted until 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Where should I send my application?
faq.answer: Email your CV and other relevant documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Manager post?
faq.answer: A Master of Public Health, with 5 years' experience in a relevant field, which is essential.

faq.question: Q5. Is experience compulsory for the Audiologist cum Speech Therapist post?
faq.answer: No. 3 years' experience in a relevant field is listed as desirable. The required qualification is a Bachelor in Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The limit is 55 years for the Manager post and 35 years for the Audiologist cum Speech Therapist post.

faq.question: Q7. What will the Manager do?
faq.answer: The Manager liaises with the Government for approvals of health schemes, coordinates camps and publicity with PHCs and Namma clinics, and supervises ICMR NCDIR HSBR and other projects.
